arguments.text: Plan (min 1): 6000 m, legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Start hard as expected (shaft 258 W vs CP 202, pod reserve 80 pct). Expect settle by min 2-3; if shaft still above ~215 W at min 3, cue ease. Leg 1 heading north into adverse push (-0.31). Watches set: pod_reserve_low, drag_spike (rudder weed check), effort_sag, finish_zone (<1000 m). CP may be 10-25 pct off: compare pod reserve vs speed later.

arguments.text: Good start. Ease a touch now, settle into race rhythm.

Min 4 (738 m): never settled. Shaft 234 W vs CP 202 / sustainable 206; pod reserve 38 pct, empties in ~630 m. Cued ease (no pace target, because current flips each leg so a ground pace would mislead). Check at next wake: shaft should be ~205-210 W. If paddler holds ~230 W with no fade for long, CP may be underestimated (check cp_implied_w).
